Context: 13. Annual Return of Assets and Liabilities

15. Ill. Exemption of assets from filing the information.The Competent Authority can exempt from filing the information of any asset, if the value of such Asset does not exceed four months' basic pay of the public servant or ~ 2 lakhs, whichever is higher.
- GID, OM, dated 26-12-2014, Rule 45 and Sec.
17. I.
